description: Test fixture for the Image-Led path. It is not a library direction and is never shipped: Phase 2 found the Image-Led model unvalidated (research/data/analysis/image-led-test.md), so the library holds no Image-Led directions yet. tools/check.mjs builds, queries and applies it to prove the engine handles a direction with no ground.

direction.name: Fixture: Type on Photography
direction.imagery: Any photograph; the scrim protects the type whatever the image is.
direction.summary: White type on photography under a 55% black scrim.

reasoning.claim: Absolute White reaches {ratio:figure/imagery-worst} on any image under the scrim, and {ratio:figure/scrim} on a solid scrim panel.

direction.choose_if: never: this is a test fixture
do: Set long text on solid scrim panels.
avoid: Do not set body text directly on imagery.
